sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
Jubilee Oven Confectionery Limited (also known as Jubilee Oven Sweet Treats Co) is a leading FoodTech confectionery business based in Obio Akpor, Port Harcourt. Operated by experienced restaurant technology professionals, we combine cutting-edge food preparation techniques with time-honored baking traditions to create exceptional sweet treats that delight our customers.

From our location at No 2 KINIKA Road, Ogborogbo Town, we serve Port Harcourt and surrounding communities with premium cakes, pastries, bread, and confectioneries made fresh daily. Our commitment to quality ingredients, innovative recipes, and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted name in Rivers State's thriving food scene.

Whether you're celebrating a special occasion, hosting an event, or simply treating yourself, Jubilee Oven delivers sweetness with every bite.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
**Custom Celebration Cakes**
Beautifully designed birthday cakes, wedding cakes, and anniversary cakes customized to your exact specifications. From elegant tiered designs to fun themed creations, we bring your vision to life.

**Fresh Daily Pastries**
Start your day right with our selection of fresh croissants, meat pies, sausage rolls, doughnuts, and Nigerian favorites – all baked fresh every morning.

**Corporate & Event Catering**
Professional confectionery services for corporate events, weddings, birthdays, and special occasions. We handle orders of any size with efficiency and excellence.

**Artisan Bread & Confectionery**
Premium bread varieties, cookies, brownies, chin-chin, and specialty confections made with quality ingredients and authentic recipes.

**Online Ordering & Delivery**
Conveniently order through our modern platform and enjoy reliable delivery across Port Harcourt. Technology-driven service that respects your time.

**Baking Classes & Workshops**
Learn from our expert bakers in hands-on classes covering cake decoration, pastry techniques, and confectionery fundamentals.

sections.name: Contact Us
sections.copy:

**Visit Our Bakery:**

Obio Akpor, Port Harcourt, Rivers State

**Call or WhatsApp:**
+234 803 741 5174

**Business Hours:**
Monday - Saturday: 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM

Follow us on social media for daily specials, new product launches, and exclusive promotions. We look forward to serving you!
